# Supported devices

> [!NOTE]
> This page is generated from the official Teltonika Web API reference. For request payloads and response
> fields, see the [Teltonika Web API reference](https://developers.teltonika-networks.com/).

Pytonika supports **88 Teltonika models**. Each model exposes the endpoint groups
that the official [Teltonika Web API reference](https://developers.teltonika-networks.com/)
documents for it, for the firmware listed below. Each family also has a generic class with
the endpoint groups common to all its models.

Operations added in a newer firmware than the one running on your device return an error
from the device. See [endpoints.md](endpoints.md) for the methods of each endpoint group.

- [Routers](#routers) (66)
- [Gateways](#gateways) (14)
- [Access points](#access-points) (3)
- [Switches](#switches) (5)
